---
title: "Hazelnut seasonality"
description: "Does the Giresun hazelnut price follow the harvest calendar? Average price by month of the season, as a change from the season's mean."
---

```{python}
from hazelnut.site import charts
from hazelnut.site import page_helpers as ph
from hazelnut.site.config import SITE_DIR, load_crops

crop = load_crops()["hazelnut"]
data_dir = SITE_DIR / "data" / crop.slug
local = crop.local_currency
manifest = ph.read_json_or_none(data_dir / "manifest.json")
stamp = ph.as_of_stamp(manifest) if manifest is not None else None

prices = ph.read_csv_or_none(data_dir / "prices_monthly.csv",
                             required=("month", "season", "usd_kg", local.column))
profile = ph.seasonal_profile(prices, "usd_kg") if prices is not None else None
if profile is not None and profile.empty:
    profile = None
```

```{python}
if profile is None:
    found = ("The price follows the harvest calendar only weakly; the chart below shows "
             "the average month against its season's mean.")
else:
    lo = profile.loc[profile["mean"].idxmin()]
    hi = profile.loc[profile["mean"].idxmax()]
    spread = round(float((profile["q75"] - profile["q25"]).median()) * 100)
    found = (
        f"The price does follow the season, but only just. Averaged over "
        f"{int(profile['seasons'].max())} seasons it is lowest in {lo['label']} "
        f"({ph.fmt_change(lo['mean'])} from the season's mean) and highest in {hi['label']} "
        f"({ph.fmt_change(hi['mean'])}). One season's own ups and downs are far bigger: in a "
        f"typical month the middle half of seasons spans {spread} points, so the calendar "
        "alone is a weak guide to next month's price."
    )
ph.raw_html(ph.analysis_head_html(crop.name, "Seasonality",
                                  "Does the price follow the harvest calendar?", found, stamp))
```

::: {.dash}

::: {#panel-season .panel .span-12}
```{python}
TITLE = "Average price by month of the season"
if profile is None:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, "Each month's price as a change from its season's mean."))
    ph.raw_html(ph.unavailable_html())
else:
    ph.raw_html(ph.panel_head_html(TITLE, ph.seasonality_subtitle(profile)))
    charts.show(charts.season_profile(profile))
    # The same profile in the local currency, for the footnote (its slide tilts every season).
    local_profile = ph.seasonal_profile(prices, local.column)
    local_note = ""
    if not local_profile.empty:
        local_note = (
            f" In {local.label} the averages run from "
            f"{ph.fmt_change(local_profile['mean'].min())} to "
            f"{ph.fmt_change(local_profile['mean'].max())}, because the currency's slide "
            "lifts prices through every season."
        )
    ph.raw_html(
        '<p class="foot">Giresun exchange monthly average, USD per kg. Seasons run September '
        "to August; only complete seasons are counted. Bars: the average across seasons; "
        f"whiskers: the middle half of seasons.{ph.escape(local_note)}</p>"
    )
```
